# === Import Directives ===

--8<-- [start:import_from]
-import_from(utils, [Double, Helper])
--8<-- [end:import_from]

--8<-- [start:import_from_ex2]
-import_from(utils, [alias(Double, MyDouble)])
--8<-- [end:import_from_ex2]

--8<-- [start:import_module]
-import_module(utils)
--8<-- [end:import_module]


# === Predicate Property Directives ===

--8<-- [start:meta_predicate]
-meta_predicate(my_map(2, +, -))
--8<-- [end:meta_predicate]


# === Specialization Directive ===

--8<-- [start:specialize]
-specialize(SolveCount, NatnumProgram, alias=SolveCountNatnum)
--8<-- [end:specialize]

--8<-- [start:specialize_ex2]
-specialize(MI, Source, alias=Name, depth=5)     # deep unfolding
-specialize(MI, Source, alias=Name, cpd=True)     # conjunctive partial deduction
--8<-- [end:specialize_ex2]


# === EDCG Directives ===

--8<-- [start:edcg_pred]
-edcg_pred(scaled_inc, 0, [counter, scale])
--8<-- [end:edcg_pred]


# === Atom-identity Directives (GLOBAL_ATOMS_DEFAULT.md) ===

--8<-- [start:module_with_atoms]
-module(traffic, [phase(X), red, amber, green])
--8<-- [end:module_with_atoms]

--8<-- [start:module_data_functor]
-module(shapes, [point(X, Y), kind(S, K), point])

kind(point(X_UNUSED, Y_UNUSED), point),
--8<-- [end:module_data_functor]

--8<-- [start:module_predicate_export_vocab]
# rules.clausal -- defines verdict/2 AND exports it
-module(rules, [verdict/2])

verdict(ok, cited),
--8<-- [end:module_predicate_export_vocab]

--8<-- [start:module_predicate_export_impl]
# checks.clausal -- uses it, imported from the module that defines it
-import_from(rules, [verdict])

cited_ok(C) <- verdict(ok, C)
--8<-- [end:module_predicate_export_impl]

--8<-- [start:private_with_atoms]
-private([draft, internal_only])
--8<-- [end:private_with_atoms]

--8<-- [start:strict_atoms]
-strict_atoms
-module(immigration_rules, [eligible(X), denied(X, Reason)])
-private([visa_type, application_status])
-import_from(atoms, [ok, error, pending])
--8<-- [end:strict_atoms]

--8<-- [start:hide]
-module(vault, [check(X)])
-hide([vault_secret])
--8<-- [end:hide]

--8<-- [start:double_quotes]
-double_quotes(chars)      # "hello" is the string ['h','e','l','l','o'] (the default)
# -double_quotes(atom)     # "hello" is the atom hello (the opt-out)

greeting("hello"),         # a string under chars, an atom under atom
tag('hello'),              # ALWAYS the atom hello, in either mode
raw(b"hello"),             # ALWAYS a list of integer codes
--8<-- [end:double_quotes]
